mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies around the Military Ridge State Trail with a waxing crescent moon lighting up the night.

The City of Verona has reached a major milestone with the Common Council unanimously adopting the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which will serve as our roadmap for future development. Additionally, the city is continuing its commitment to public engagement and sustainable infrastructure projects.

There is plenty to do around town with Hop Haus Trivia taking place today. Tomorrow is packed with activities, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus yoga at Insight Wellness and live music at Paddy Mac's.
Regarding the weekly police report, an officer conducted a traffic stop on October 3 and discovered a 19-year-old driver was in possession of a stolen firearm, leading to his arrest.
Culver's of Verona is ready for you to enjoy today's flavor, OREO Cookie Cheesecake, when they open today at 10:00 AM.
